reason: Planks and a wooden chest seem useful for building the grain bin.
expectation: I expect a grain bin or a component for one.

reaction: The chest and planks produced the expected bin.
reason: Planks and net suggest a rack for drying the fruit before packing it.
expectation: I expect a drying rack or another way to dry fruit.

effect: The drying rack is ready, so I can use it to prepare the fruit.
reaction: The rack came together as expected.
reason: Drying the fruit is the next step toward the fruit crock.

alternatives.reason: The jar and lid could make a covered vessel, but I want to prepare the fruit first.

expectation: I expect a covered jar that can hold the dried fruit.

reaction: The vessel came together as expected.
reason: The only offered combination should complete the fruit crock.

effect: The dried fruit and covered jar made the fruit crock, completing the final goal.
reaction: The result was expected and brought the chapter to a clear finish.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the drying rack was the most worthwhile choice: it connected the available materials to preserving the fruit.

leastWorthwhile.text: Covering the jar felt routine, especially with only one combination offered.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the results matched my expectations.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary, though adding planks to a wooden chest to make a grain bin was a fairly abstract construction.

continue.text: I would be unlikely to continue personally: the combinations made sense, but this chapter offered little uncertainty or surprise.
